description: This file defines a Flutter UI widget named `Cell` that represents a single cell in a Tic-Tac-Toe game grid. It manages visual styling based on the cell's value ('X', 'O', or empty), highlighting, and tap interactions.

classes.name: Cell
classes.description: A stateless widget representing a game cell with configurable value, tap behavior, and highlighting.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the visual representation of the cell, including styling based on the value and highlight states.
